text: Review blueprints to determine customer requirements and consult with assembler regarding schematics, wiring procedures, or conductor paths.
Dismantle machinery and equipment for shipment to installation site, performing installation and maintenance work as part of team.
Troubleshoot new or existing product problems involving designs, materials, or processes.
Converse with customers to determine details of equipment problems.
Grind, file, and sand parts to finished dimensions.
Maintain records and compile statistical reports concerning personnel-related data, such as hires, transfers, performance appraisals, and absenteeism rates.
Organize and supervise activities, such as the processing of incoming and outgoing mail.
Conduct searches to find needed information, using such sources as the Internet.

Review reports of securities transactions or price lists to analyze market conditions.
Complete and maintain necessary records.
Perform clerical duties, such as taking inventory, ordering supplies, answering telephone, taking messages, or filling out forms.

Analyze operations to evaluate performance of a company or its staff in meeting objectives or to determine areas of potential cost reduction, program improvement, or policy change.
